scope: Aggregate support scan of the released ToolACE target candidates; no model outcomes are included.

definitions.candidate_targets: Assistant messages in the released source data whose value begins with a list-form target.
definitions.targets: Candidate targets successfully parsed by the frozen support scan.
definitions.maximum_sequence_tokens: Maximum prompt-plus-response token count among parsed targets.

redistribution: Only aggregate values and source hashes are included here; the third-party dataset and per-target records are not redistributed.
